changeFailed: The change could not be saved. Try again.
openFolderTitle: Open a folder to schedule reviews
openFolderDescription: Schedules and their run history are saved inside the folder you open.

allowHere.waiting: Switched on in this folder, not on this Mac, so it does not run here. Allow it to run it exactly as written below.
allowHere.changed: Switched on in this folder and changed since this Mac allowed it, so it does not run here until you allow it again.
allowHere.paused: Not allowed on this Mac yet, so Run now waits too. Allow it to run it exactly as written below.
allowHere.noNextRun: Runs here only after you allow it
allowHere.limit: at most {count} new documents a pass

scheduleCount: {count, plural, one {# scheduled automation} other {# scheduled automations}}
title: Automations
lede: Schedule recurring reviews, then inspect what each run found. They run on this computer while Atlas is open.
appRequiredTitle: Automations run in the desktop app
appRequiredDescription: Open your folder in the app to create schedules right on this screen.
malformedDescription: Atlas could not read the local schedule file and left it unchanged. Fix it, then read again.
unavailableTitle: Atlas could not read this folder's schedules
unavailableDescription: Atlas could not read .ontology-atlas/rounds.json in this folder, so its schedules cannot be shown or run. Check the folder is where Atlas opened it, then read again.

unrecorded.ledger: The run at {time} ended but could not be written to {file}, so it is not in this history. The schedule moved on to its next time. Check that this folder can be written to.
unrecorded.schedule: The run at {time} ended but its next time could not be written to {file}. Atlas keeps that time on this Mac until the file can be written. Check that this folder can be written to.

editWidens: This change lets the schedule do more than this Mac allowed. Saving allows the new version on this Mac.
noSummary: The pass finished without a stored summary.
failedNoResult: The agent turn did not finish, so this run left no result.
noAgentReview: No coding agent was ready on this Mac, so this review did not run. Open Agents to sign in, then run it again.
failedError: This run stopped on an error: {detail}. Run it again; if the same error comes back, open the folder again.
failedFolderNotRead: Atlas had not finished reading this folder, so this run checked nothing. Run it again in a moment.

undone.restored: Atlas put {page} back as it was before this run.
undone.removed: Atlas removed {page}, which this run had created.
undone.failed: Atlas could not put {page} back after this run. Open it and check it before you rely on it.

saveFailed: The schedule could not be saved. Nothing was changed.

ontology.info: Read-only ACP passes that inspect the ontology and source evidence, then leave a bounded review packet.
ontology.count: {count, plural, =0 {No ontology reviews} one {# ontology review} other {# ontology reviews}}
ontology.title: Ontology refinement

runs.title: What it does
runs.body: The in-app coding agent reads the graph and its source links, then leaves one bounded improvement proposal.

when.title: When it runs
when.body: On the cadence you pick, such as hourly, every six hours or daily. A run missed while the app was closed runs once when it next opens.

writes.title: What it may change
writes.body: Nothing. You review each proposal and apply it on the map yourself.

ontology.emptyTitle: No ontology review is scheduled yet
ontology.emptyDescription: All it needs is a name and a cadence. The focus area is optional.

sheet.title: Schedule an ontology review
sheet.description: Atlas will open one guarded ACP turn at the chosen time, inspect the ontology and code evidence, and leave a review-only packet.
sheet.focusPlaceholder: source binding gaps, stale capabilities, relation evidence…
sheet.focusHint: Leave it empty and Atlas chooses one bounded area from the current evidence.
sheet.mayRead: Read the ontology and current source evidence through atlas-vault.
sheet.mayPropose: Describe proposed changes with exact slugs, paths, and uncertainty.
sheet.mayNeverWrite: Never write concepts, relations, files, or a meaning receipt.

documents.info: Existing Library rounds refresh sources and redraft wiki pages under their approved standing scope.
documents.count: {count, plural, =0 {No document rounds} one {# document round} other {# document rounds}}
documents.title: Document analysis
documents.guard: Changes only the approved Library scope · never the ontology

runs.title: What it does
runs.body: Checks that sources and wiki pages still match, and pulls changed pages from a connected service.

when.title: When it runs
when.body: On the cadence you pick, such as hourly, every six hours or daily. A run missed while the app was closed runs once when it next opens.

writes.title: What it may change
writes.body: Only sources and wiki drafts inside the approved Library scope. Never the ontology.

documents.emptyTitle: No document round is scheduled yet
documents.emptyDescription: Page-by-page review and the full run ledger continue in the Library.
